Level 50 (fixed — Champions rules)
Stat formula (verified against Pokémon Champions): HP = Base + 75 + Points. Other stats = floor((Base + 20 + Points) × Nature alignment), where alignment is ×1.1 / ×0.9 / ×1.0. Champions has no separate EV/IV system — Stat Points (0–32 per stat, 66 total) are the only thing you allocate, and every mon is otherwise treated as maxed-out at Level 50.
